title: Genesis AI is in talks to raise about $500m for its robot brains
summary: Should it close, the raise would slot Genesis into a run of outsized robotics cheques. Genesis emerged from stealth in July 2025 with a $105m seed round co-led by Eclipse Ventures and Khosla Ventures, among the larger seeds of that year.
